principles: Only fix the observed correctness gap
Keep reviewer guidance separate from receipt-backed proof
Preserve existing quality reviewer role and prompt shape
Make regression coverage fail closed if key language is removed
drivers: Baseline item 2 requires job metadata and linked run metadata coverage
Scope excludes server business logic and receipt verification changes
The immutable baseline must remain unchanged

options.name: prompt-and-smoke-only
pros: Directly fixes the workflow guidance gap
cons: Does not by itself prove production receipt correctness

options.name: server-logic-change
pros: Could enforce proof metadata at runtime
cons: Out of scope for this story
Would mix workflow baseline item with server behavior

rationale: The target is a real reviewer guidance correctness gap, so a narrow prompt plus smoke regression is sufficient and avoids changing unrelated runtime behavior.
